title: What does return content attribute of template element?
body:
You can find in spec [the next](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/scripting.html#dom-template-content):

> The content getter steps are to return [template](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/scripting.html#the-template-element)'s [template contents](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/scripting.html#template-contents), if the [template contents](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/scripting.html#template-contents) is not a [ShadowRoot](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-shadowroot) node; otherwise null.

We see that the **content** attribute may return the `null` value, interesting...

Maybe [template contents](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/scripting.html#template-contents) algorithm may say more?
> 1. Let doc be the [template](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/scripting.html#the-template-element) element's [node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)'s [appropriate template contents owner document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/scripting.html#appropriate-template-contents-owner-document).
> 
> 2. Create a [DocumentFragment](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-documentfragment) object whose [node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) is doc and [host](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-documentfragment-host) is the [template](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/scripting.html#the-template-element) element.
> 
> 3. Set the [template](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/scripting.html#the-template-element) element's [template contents](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/scripting.html#template-contents) to the newly created [DocumentFragment](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-documentfragment) object.

Well, the **template contents** return the **DocumentFragment** constantly.

So where is the case when `template.content` return the `null` value?

---

I found the [case when template contents of template has a shadow root](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#parsing-main-inhead:template-contents).

> 1. [Attach a shadow root](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-attach-a-shadow-root) with declarative shadow host element, mode, clonable, serializable, delegatesFocus, and "named". If an exception is thrown, then catch it, [report the exception](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#report-the-exception), [insert an element at the adjusted insertion location](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#insert-an-element-at-the-adjusted-insertion-location) with template, and return.
> 
> 2. Let shadow be declarative shadow host element's [shadow root](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-shadow-root).
> 
> 3. Set shadow's [declarative](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#shadowroot-declarative) to true.
> 
> 4. Set [template](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/scripting.html#the-template-element)'s [template contents](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/scripting.html#template-contents) property to shadow.
> 
> 5. Set shadow's [available to element internals](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#shadowroot-available-to-element-internals) to true.

But how can I see reflection of 4 step? When and where can I write `template.content` and get the `null` value? Thanks.
